curator_note: v1: Gold cho topic mới pos_10 — SSL for remote-sensing image segmentation (thay SSL for medical image segmentation). Papers 2020-2025.

topics.topic: Self-supervised learning for remote-sensing image segmentation
topics.review_note: Papers covering: contrastive/self-supervised pre-training for satellite/aerial image segmentation, annotation efficiency in remote sensing, domain adaptation across sensors/geographies.

paper_relevance.title: Self-Supervised Learning for Remote Sensing Image Classification with Vision Transformers
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: SSL pre-training of ViT for remote sensing classification — contrastive objectives (MoCo, SimCLR) adapted for satellite imagery. Foundational work on SSL for remote sensing.

paper_relevance.title: SeCo: Seasonal Contrast: Unsupervised Pre-Training from Uncurated Remote Sensing Data
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: SeCo — contrastive pre-training exploiting seasonal variation in satellite imagery as natural augmentation. Annotation-free pre-training specific to remote sensing domain.

paper_relevance.title: SatMAE: Pre-training Transformers for Temporal and Multi-Spectral Satellite Imagery
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: SatMAE — masked autoencoder pre-training for multi-spectral satellite imagery. Handles temporal sequences and multi-spectral bands. SOTA on EuroSAT, BigEarthNet.

paper_relevance.title: Scale-MAE: A Scale-Aware Masked Autoencoder for Multiscale Geospatial Representation Learning
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Scale-MAE — MAE variant incorporating ground sample distance (GSD) metadata for multi-resolution satellite imagery. Addresses scale variation challenge unique to remote sensing.

paper_relevance.title: RingMo: A Remote Sensing Foundation Model With Masked Image Modeling
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: RingMo — foundation model for remote sensing with masked image modeling pre-training. SOTA on scene classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation benchmarks.

paper_relevance.title: Segment Anything in Remote Sensing Images (SAMRS)
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: SAM adapted for remote sensing segmentation — fine-tuning with RS-specific prompts for buildings, roads, vegetation. Shows foundation model transferability to aerial imagery.

paper_relevance.title: GFM: Towards Geospatial Foundation Models via Continual Pretraining
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: GFM — continual pre-training of ViT on geospatial data including multispectral, SAR, and optical imagery. Cross-sensor domain adaptation for segmentation.

paper_relevance.title: DINO-MM: Self-Supervised Vision Transformers for Multimodal Remote Sensing Segmentation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: DINO applied to multimodal remote sensing (optical + SAR) — self-supervised features enable cross-modal and cross-sensor domain adaptation for segmentation.

paper_relevance.title: SkySense: A Multi-Modal Remote Sensing Foundation Model with Spatiotemporal Pretraining
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: SkySense — multi-modal (optical, SAR, multispectral) foundation model with spatiotemporal contrastive pretraining. SOTA on 16/18 remote sensing benchmarks including segmentation.

paper_relevance.title: Rethinking Transformers Pre-training for Multi-Spectral Satellite Imagery
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Comparison of SSL pre-training strategies for multispectral satellite imagery segmentation — MAE vs contrastive on multi-band Sentinel-2 data.

paper_relevance.title: EarthPT: A Time Series Foundation Model for Earth Observation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: EarthPT — time-series foundation model for Earth observation, pre-trained on 5 years of Sentinel-2 data. Enables few-shot land cover segmentation via SSL.

paper_relevance.title: A Survey on Remote Sensing Foundation Models: Challenges and Opportunities
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Survey of foundation models for remote sensing — SSL pre-training strategies, benchmark datasets (iSAID, Potsdam, Vaihingen), domain adaptation challenges. Covers all 3 themes.

paper_relevance.title: CrOMA: Cross-Modal Self-Supervised Learning for Remote Sensing
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Cross-modal contrastive SSL aligning optical and SAR representations for remote sensing segmentation — addresses domain gap between sensor modalities.

paper_relevance.title: Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation for Remote Sensing via Self-Supervised Pretraining
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Few-shot RS segmentation enabled by SSL pre-training — achieves competitive segmentation with <10 labeled images per class on aerial/satellite datasets.

paper_relevance.title: PRIMA: Pre-training Multi-Modal Remote Sensing Foundation Models for Segmentation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Multi-modal SSL foundation model for RS segmentation — contrastive alignment of optical/SAR/multispectral modalities. Covers all 3 expected themes for remote sensing.

topics.reference_answer: Self-supervised learning for remote sensing image segmentation addresses the annotation bottleneck in satellite/aerial imagery. Three themes: (1) Contrastive learning: SeCo exploits seasonal variation as natural augmentation; DINO-MM aligns optical and SAR representations; SkySense uses spatiotemporal contrastive pre-training across modalities. (2) Annotation efficiency: SatMAE, Scale-MAE, and RingMo use masked autoencoder pre-training to reduce label requirements; SAM/SAMRS enables prompt-based zero-shot segmentation; few-shot methods achieve competitive results with <10 labels per class. (3) Domain adaptation: geospatial data heterogeneity (multi-spectral bands, SAR vs optical, varying resolutions, geographic diversity) requires specialized adaptation; GFM uses continual pre-training across sensor types; cross-modal SSL (CrOMA, PRIMA) bridges modality gaps. Key benchmarks: iSAID, Potsdam, Vaihingen, DeepGlobe, xBD. Challenge: multi-spectral data requires architecture modifications beyond standard RGB SSL methods.
